title: 學華語向前走 2B — Lesson 10
description: Vocabulary from lesson 10 of the textbook 學華語向前走 (Let's Learn Mandarin) 2B, with original example sentences written for young beginners (Traditional characters).

exampleSentences.pinyin: jīntiān shì shǔjià dì yī tiān.
exampleSentences.english: Today is the first day of summer vacation.

exampleSentences.pinyin: shǔjià hěn cháng, wǒ hěn kāixīn.
exampleSentences.english: The summer holiday is long, and I'm very happy.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de shǔjià zuòyè zuòwán le.
exampleSentences.english: I've finished my summer holiday homework.

exampleSentences.pinyin: shǔjià wǒmen qù hǎibiān wán.
exampleSentences.english: In the summer holidays we go to the beach to play.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ qù kàn jiùjiu.
exampleSentences.english: I'm going to visit my uncle.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ xīngqīliù lái kàn wǒ ma?
exampleSentences.english: Will you come to visit me on Saturday?

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen jīntiān qù kàn nǎinai.
exampleSentences.english: We're going to visit Grandma today.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhōumò wǒmen qù kàn yéye.
exampleSentences.english: On the weekend we go to visit Grandpa.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè běnlái shì wǒ de shū.
exampleSentences.english: This was originally my book.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我本來想去公園，但是下雨了。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ běnlái xiǎng qù gōngyuán, dànshì xiàyǔ le.
exampleSentences.english: I was originally going to go to the park, but it rained.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我的球本來放在這裡，現在不見了。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de qiú běnlái fàng zài zhèlǐ, xiànzài bújiàn le.
exampleSentences.english: My ball was originally here, but now it's gone.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我本來想吃蘋果，現在想吃香蕉。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ běnlái xiǎng chī píngguǒ, xiànzài xiǎng chī xiāngjiāo.
exampleSentences.english: At first I wanted an apple, but now I want a banana.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ zhùzài Àozhōu.
exampleSentences.english: I live in Australia.

exampleSentences.pinyin: tā zhùzài Táiběi.
exampleSentences.english: He lives in Taipei.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我的朋友住在我家附近。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de péngyou zhùzài wǒ jiā fùjìn.
exampleSentences.english: My friend lives near my house.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我們住在有大花園的房子裡。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen zhùzài yǒu dà huāyuán de fángzi lǐ.
exampleSentences.english: We live in a house with a big garden.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Táiběi hěn dà.
exampleSentences.english: Taipei is big.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Táiběi zài Táiwān.
exampleSentences.english: Taipei is in Taiwan.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我們去臺北的動物園玩。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen qù Táiběi de dòngwùyuán wán.
exampleSentences.english: We go to the zoo in Taipei to play.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 爺爺說臺北的夜市很好吃。
exampleSentences.pinyin: yéye shuō Táiběi de yèshì hěn hǎochī.
exampleSentences.english: Grandpa says the night markets in Taipei have yummy food.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǎinai tuìxiū le.
exampleSentences.english: Grandma has retired.

exampleSentences.pinyin: lǎoshī míngnián tuìxiū.
exampleSentences.english: The teacher retires next year.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 爺爺退休以後，每天在公園散步。
exampleSentences.pinyin: yéye tuìxiū yǐhòu, měitiān zài gōngyuán sànbù.
exampleSentences.english: After retiring, Grandpa goes for a walk in the park every day.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 爸爸還沒退休，他每天上班。
exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba hái méi tuìxiū, tā měitiān shàngbān.
exampleSentences.english: Dad hasn't retired yet, so he goes to work every day.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 媽媽的弟弟是我的舅舅。
exampleSentences.pinyin: māma de dìdi shì wǒ de jiùjiu.
exampleSentences.english: Mum's younger brother is my uncle.

exampleSentences.pinyin: jiùjiu yǒu yì zhī gǒu.
exampleSentences.english: Uncle has a dog.

exampleSentences.pinyin: jiùjiu zhōumò dài wǒ qù yóuyǒng.
exampleSentences.english: On weekends Uncle takes me swimming.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 媽媽說舅舅明天來我家。
exampleSentences.pinyin: māma shuō jiùjiu míngtiān lái wǒ jiā.
exampleSentences.english: Mum says Uncle is coming to our house tomorrow.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Táinán zài Táiwān.
exampleSentences.english: Tainan is in Taiwan.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Táinán zài Táiběi de nánfāng.
exampleSentences.english: Tainan is south of Taipei.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 暑假我們坐火車去臺南。
exampleSentences.pinyin: shǔjià wǒmen zuò huǒchē qù Táinán.
exampleSentences.english: In the summer holidays we take the train to Tainan.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我最喜歡吃臺南的芒果。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ zuì xǐhuan chī Táinán de mángguǒ.
exampleSentences.english: I love eating Tainan's mangoes.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ zhǐ qù guo yícì dòngwùyuán.
exampleSentences.english: I've only been to the zoo once.

exampleSentences.pinyin: qǐng zài shuō yícì.
exampleSentences.english: Please say it one more time.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ měi xīngqī qù yícì yóuyǒng.
exampleSentences.english: I go swimming once a week.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 一次吃太多糖，牙齒會痛。
exampleSentences.pinyin: yícì chī tài duō táng, yáchǐ huì tòng.
exampleSentences.english: Eating too much sugar at once makes your teeth hurt.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Niǔyuē zài Měiguó.
exampleSentences.english: New York is in the United States.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 紐約很遠，我們要坐飛機。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Niǔyuē hěn yuǎn, wǒmen yào zuò fēijī.
exampleSentences.english: New York is far away, so we have to take a plane.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我的玩具熊是在紐約買的。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de wánjùxióng shì zài Niǔyuē mǎi de.
exampleSentences.english: My teddy bear was bought in New York.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 阿姨在紐約，她常寄卡片給我。
exampleSentences.pinyin: āyí zài Niǔyuē, tā cháng jì kǎpiàn gěi wǒ.
exampleSentences.english: My aunt is in New York, and she often sends me cards.

words.definition: to travel, to take a trip

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan lǚxíng.
exampleSentences.english: I like travelling.

exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba hé māma qù lǚxíng.
exampleSentences.english: Dad and Mum are going on a trip.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 這個暑假我們要去旅行。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhège shǔjià wǒmen yào qù lǚxíng.
exampleSentences.english: This summer holiday we're going on a trip.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 旅行的時候要帶水和帽子。
exampleSentences.pinyin: lǚxíng de shíhou yào dài shuǐ hé màozi.
exampleSentences.english: When you go travelling, bring water and a hat.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Fǎguó zài Ōuzhōu.
exampleSentences.english: France is in Europe.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng qù Fǎguó.
exampleSentences.english: I want to go to France.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 爸爸從法國帶了禮物給我。
exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba cóng Fǎguó dài le lǐwù gěi wǒ.
exampleSentences.english: Dad brought me a present from France.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我的同學說他去過法國。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de tóngxué shuō tā qù guo Fǎguó.
exampleSentences.english: My classmate says he has been to France.
